# routeros_disk_btrfs_transfer (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The direction of the transfer.
  * receive - accept a stream from a remote device;
  * send - send subvolumes to a remote device.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `file` (String) The mount path the received snapshots are written to, or the file the stream is read from or written to.
- `fs` (String) The label of the Btrfs file system taking part in the transfer.
- `send_parent` (String) The parent snapshot used to send an incremental stream instead of a full one.
- `send_subvolumes` (String) The subvolumes that are sent to the remote device.
- `ssh_address` (String) The address of the remote device the snapshots are transferred to or from.
- `ssh_port` (Number) The SSH port of the remote device.
- `ssh_receive_mount` (String) The destination path on the remote device the received snapshots are stored in.
- `ssh_user` (String) The user on the remote device that is authorized for the transfer operation.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (String) The number of bytes that have been transferred so far.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of the transfer.
